partial_expected_on_segments.ambiguity_reason: partial or dim frequency segment interiors

mandatory_gates_in_order: The candidate is one maximal nonempty primary_frequency ambiguous run with exactly the reason assigned to its recorded branch; unreadable frames and all other ambiguity reasons are rejected.

The refusal lies in the nearest source-consecutive episode closed by two readable supports on each side; all four independently derive the same canonical DD.DDD value before any current target is consulted.
The support-derived value then exactly equals the event current target and every interior sample current target.

Every claimed frame is product-unresolved solely in primary_frequency, no field is DIFFERENCE, every other field is MATCH, and joint state is MATCH or is UNRESOLVED while primary_frequency is the sole unresolved field.
All four support frames are exact current comparisons with joint state MATCH.
The authenticated recording-wide maximum source interval is retained exactly and is no greater than the 1 s sanity ceiling; it does not loosen a candidate chain.

Video and source indices are consecutive, every gap is no greater than the smaller of the verified recording-wide maximum and the fixed 10 ms support-chain maximum, the refusal run spans at most 75 ms, and the full support chain spans at most 300 ms.

Every support and interior frame has the fixed five digit origins, seven segment measurements that exactly reproduce the raw masks, an on decimal, and two clear holes per digit; every intervening readable frame is the same exact current value and every intervening refusal belongs to one of the recorded branches.

Every expected-off segment is off and every expected-on segment is on except for the partial branch's directly measured partial expected-on segments; an expected-on segment that is fully off and any unexpected-on or unexpected-partial segment are rejected.

The intact_mask branch has no partial segments. Each partial_expected_on_segments frame has one or two partial expected-on segments, each with p10 at least 13 levels above the largest expected-off p90 in that frame.
The 13-level partial-to-off separation is the difference between reader7's independently frozen on p10 threshold of 45 and off p90 threshold of 32; it is not fitted to candidate outcomes.

The record names its claimed-run branch and all branches observed in its closing context, affects primary_frequency only, contains one contiguous unique video-frame run, and retains the full source-consecutive exact-current context which brackets that run.

The RAW_CURRENT_BRACKETED_UNRESOLVED_VERIFICATION_BOUNDARY claim can close a verification boundary only when the product judge independently finds raw CURRENT observations immediately around the complete classified refusal run and every record covering that run contains those exact bracket indices. It changes no raw observation and is usable only through an exact product-policy allowlist entry.

profile.sample: max-channel segment p10, median, and p90

scope.claim: A bounded raw frequency refusal preserves the exact support-derived canonical glyph geometry between source-consecutive same-value readable supports.
does_not_claim: a raw reader value for any ambiguous frame

validation.observer_eligibility_rule: SAME_FREQUENCY_GLYPHS_THROUGHOUT with BOTH_CLEAR endpoints, LEGAL_TARGET_CONTENT, and HIGH confidence
